frequency_question: How often have scheduled monthly CPI releases been published on their designated release dates without structural procedural failure over the last 5 years?
membership_rule: Includes all regular monthly consumer price index publications by MoSPI; excludes ad-hoc revisions or base-year overhauls.
provenance_note: claims 48 cases from only 4 named (12.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 48 named monthly releases; complete population for the specified 4-year block.
known_gaps: None; the operational pipeline for CPI compilation in India has followed a consistent physical schedule.
skeleton: 4 years of monthly releases (12 months per year) plus completed months of 2025
multiplier: 48 monthly cycles evaluated for adherence to the standard ~12-14 day reporting window
validity_reason: The administrative and collection machinery for national CPI operates on fixed statutory timelines that change only during base-year revisions.
